name: PHILIP
canonical: Philip the evangelist, a lean travel-hardened first-century Jewish disciple of about forty, sun-warmed olive skin, an earnest open eager face, dark hair and a neatly trimmed dark beard, dressed in a simple coarse sand-coloured tunic and mantle with a leather satchel and worn sandals, striding the desert road beside the chariot
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
